text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a dirty, grubby prisoner.
source_text: You see a dirty, grubby prisoner.

text: 你看见一个又肮脏又邋遢的囚犯。
source_text: 你看见一个又肮脏又邋遢的囚犯。

text: One prisoner in the second cell is not like the others. He stands# tall and looks you squarely in the eye.
source_text:
One prisoner in the second cell is not like the others. He stands
# tall and looks you squarely in the eye.

text: 在第二个房间的犯人和其它房间的不太一样。他是个大个子，站在那里盯着你。
source_text: 在第二个房间的犯人和其它房间的不太一样。他是个大个子，站在那里盯着你。

text: The prisoner stares blankly at the wall.
source_text: The prisoner stares blankly at the wall.

text: 囚犯茫然的看着墙壁。
source_text: 囚犯茫然的看着墙壁。

text: The prisoner ignores your attempts to talk.
source_text: The prisoner ignores your attempts to talk.

text: 囚犯根本没有理会你和他说话。
source_text: 囚犯根本没有理会你和他说话。

text: He looks wildly at you for a moment, and then turns away.
source_text: He looks wildly at you for a moment, and then turns away.

text: 他用毫无顾忌的眼神看了你一会，然后扭头回去了。
source_text: 他用毫无顾忌的眼神看了你一会，然后扭头回去了。

text: She looks at you for a moment, and then drools.
source_text: She looks at you for a moment, and then drools.

text: 她看了你一会，然后开始流口水说胡话。
source_text: 她看了你一会，然后开始流口水说胡话。

text: You get no response.
source_text: You get no response.

text: 你没有得到回应。
source_text: 你没有得到回应。

text: We're free! We're free!
source_text: We're free! We're free!

text: 我们自由了！我们自由了！
source_text: 我们自由了！我们自由了！

text: Your kind is repugnant. Do not speak to me.
source_text: Your kind is repugnant. Do not speak to me.

text: 你和我们不是一个种类。不要和我讲话。
source_text: 你和我们不是一个种类。不要和我讲话。

text: Quib!
source_text: Quib!

text: 垃圾！
source_text: 垃圾！

text: You don't have the right to speak to me like that.
source_text: You don't have the right to speak to me like that.

text: 你没有权利对我那样说话。
source_text: 你没有权利对我那样说话。

text: You don't understand. I'm here to free you.
source_text: You don't understand. I'm here to free you.

text: 你不明白。我是来放你出去的。
source_text: 你不明白。我是来放你出去的。

text: Do not mock me.
source_text: Do not mock me.

text: 别来耍我。
source_text: 别来耍我。

text: I have no rights, and I could care less. Go away, and leave us alone.
source_text: I have no rights, and I could care less. Go away, and leave us alone.

text: 我没有这个权利，我也不关心，你快走，让我独自待会。
source_text: 我没有这个权利，我也不关心，你快走，让我独自待会。

text: I refuse to tell you any information. Leave me alone.
source_text: I refuse to tell you any information. Leave me alone.

text: 我不会告诉你任何事情。走开。
source_text: 我不会告诉你任何事情。走开。

text: Hng!!
source_text: Hng!!

text: I'm really here to free you. I'm a normal human.
source_text: I'm really here to free you. I'm a normal human.

text: 我真的是来这里放你们走的。我是一个正常的人类。
source_text: 我真的是来这里放你们走的。我是一个正常的人类。

text: If you want it that way. Sure. Goodbye.
source_text: If you want it that way. Sure. Goodbye.

text: 如果你想要那样。没问题。再见。
source_text: 如果你想要那样。没问题。再见。

text: Don't you remember that you tried that trick last week? I didn't# fall for it then, and I'm not going to start now.
source_text:
Don't you remember that you tried that trick last week? I didn't
# fall for it then, and I'm not going to start now.

text: 你不记得上周骗我的小手段了吗？上次我没有上当，这次也不会。
source_text: 你不记得上周骗我的小手段了吗？上次我没有上当，这次也不会。

text: What? No cowl to hind behind? Your traitorous nature is self-evident.
source_text: What? No cowl to hind behind? Your traitorous nature is self-evident.

text: 什么？没有穿长袍？你就是坏人！
source_text: 什么？没有穿长袍？你就是坏人！

text: I'm here to free you.
source_text: I'm here to free you.

text: 我是来让你们获得自由的。
source_text: 我是来让你们获得自由的。

text: Goodbye, then.
source_text: Goodbye, then.

text: 那么再见。
source_text: 那么再见。

text: You are cruel. Leave us alone.
source_text: You are cruel. Leave us alone.

text: 残忍的人。离我们远点。
source_text: 残忍的人。离我们远点。

text: I won't spill the beans about my people. You cannot force a man to# betray himself, you can only force a man to stop living.
source_text:
I won't spill the beans about my people. You cannot force a man to
# betray himself, you can only force a man to stop living.

text: 我不会出卖我们的人，你可以要了我的命，但是不能让我违背良心。
source_text: 我不会出卖我们的人，你可以要了我的命，但是不能让我违背良心。

text: You really don't get it. I'm a human being, here to rescue here.
source_text: You really don't get it. I'm a human being, here to rescue here.

text: 你真的不明白嘛。我是一个人类，到这里来救你们。
source_text: 你真的不明白嘛。我是一个人类，到这里来救你们。

text: I don't even have to force you to rot in hell. You're doing a fine# job on your own.
source_text:
I don't even have to force you to rot in hell. You're doing a fine
# job on your own.

text: 我不逼你在这个该死的地方继续腐烂。你随便好了。
source_text: 我不逼你在这个该死的地方继续腐烂。你随便好了。

text: You're still mocking me.
source_text: You're still mocking me.

text: 你还在嘲笑我。
source_text: 你还在嘲笑我。

text: From the mouth of a man comes the serpent's words.
source_text: From the mouth of a man comes the serpent's words.

text: 从一个男人嘴里吐出了阴毒的字眼。
source_text: 从一个男人嘴里吐出了阴毒的字眼。

text: Right, I could guess that. Go away, and leave us alone.
source_text: Right, I could guess that. Go away, and leave us alone.

text: 对，我能猜出来。走，离我们远点。
source_text: 对，我能猜出来。走，离我们远点。

text: The prisoner looks dirty and tired. A collar around their neck is# shiny and new.
source_text:
The prisoner looks dirty and tired. A collar around their neck is
# shiny and new.

text: 那囚犯看上去又肮脏又邋遢。他的脖子上戴着一个发亮的新项圈。
source_text: 那囚犯看上去又肮脏又邋遢。他的脖子上戴着一个发亮的新项圈。

text: The prisoner looks back at you with a blank stare. You notice a# collar around their neck.
source_text:
The prisoner looks back at you with a blank stare. You notice a
# collar around their neck.

text: 那囚犯空洞的望着你的身后。你注意到他们的脖子有一个项圈。
source_text: 那囚犯空洞的望着你的身后。你注意到他们的脖子有一个项圈。

text: A sign on the wall reads: 'No Entrance. Secure Area. Prisoner# Handlers Only!'
source_text:
A sign on the wall reads: 'No Entrance. Secure Area. Prisoner
# Handlers Only!'

text: 在墙上的告示写着：“闲杂人员禁止入内。限制区域。囚犯看守除外。
source_text: 在墙上的告示写着：“闲杂人员禁止入内。限制区域。囚犯看守除外。

text: You gain
source_text: You gain

text: 你得到了
source_text: 你得到了

text: experience points for releasing prisoners from misery.
source_text: experience points for releasing prisoners from misery.

text: 点经验值，因为你把囚犯从痛苦中解救出来。
